cues.zh: 我是 Nate Harrison，2004 年冬天录制。
cues.en: This is Nate Harrison, recording in winter of 2004.

cues.zh: 我想聊聊鼓。
cues.en: I'd like to talk about drums.

cues.zh: 或者更准确地说，是一种特定的鼓点。
cues.en: Or rather, about a particular drum beat.

cues.zh: 我肯定你之前已经听过它几十次了。
cues.en: I'm sure you've heard it dozens of times before.

cues.zh: 它是流行文化声景中无处不在的一部分。
cues.en: It's a ubiquitous piece of the pop culture soundscape.

cues.zh: 从 80 年代末的匪帮说唱，到美国企业界回收嘻哈形式、向美国郊区推销吉普车和蓝色牛仔裤之类的东西，它都被当作节奏背景使用。
cues.en: It's been used as a rhythmic backdrop in everything from late '80s gangster rap to corporate America's recycling hip hop forms to sell things like Jeeps and blue jeans to suburban America.

cues.zh: 事实上，就在上周，我看到一家制药公司的电视广告，里面用这个鼓点来推广某种紫色药丸。
cues.en: In fact, just last week, I saw a TV commercial for a pharmaceutical company where this drum beat was used to promote some sort of purple pill.

cues.zh: 它被用得太多，我甚至可以说，它现在已经进入了集体听觉无意识——而且大约三四年前就进入了。
cues.en: It's been used so much, I might argue it's now entered into the collective audio unconscious and did so about three or four years ago.

cues.zh: 现在它多少被一带而过，但它其实有相当一段历史。
cues.en: It's been somewhat glossed over now, but it has quite a history to it.

cues.zh: 这个鼓点，更准确地说，这个碎拍，或者更简单地说，就是 break。
cues.en: This particular drum beat, or rather this break beat, as it is more accurately called, or even more simply, just break.

cues.zh: 这个碎拍叫 Amen。
cues.en: Well, this particular break is called the Amen.

cues.zh: Amen Break。
cues.en: The Amen Break.

cues.zh: 它听起来是这样的。
cues.en: Here's what it sounds like.

cues.zh: 来，我再放一遍。
cues.en: Here, I'll play it again.

cues.zh: 这个碎拍虽然近十多年来在当代文化中很流行、被广泛使用，但它的历史可以追溯到近 40 年前。
cues.en: Now, this break, despite its popularity and use over the last decade or so in contemporary culture, dates back almost 40 years.

cues.zh: Amen Break 是一小段音乐，得名于 1969 年发行的一首叫《Amen, Brother》的歌。
cues.en: The Amen Break is a small piece of and gets its name from a song released in 1969 titled Amen, Brother.

cues.zh: 《Amen, Brother》由一支自称 The Winstons 的放克和灵魂乐乐队录制。
cues.en: Amen, Brother was recorded by a funk and soul band who called themselves The Winstons.

cues.zh: 《Amen, Brother》是 The Winstons 发行的单曲《Color Him Father》的 B 面。
cues.en: Amen, Brother is the B-side of a single released by The Winstons titled Color Him Father.

cues.zh: 《Color Him Father》后来为乐队赢得了格莱美奖，并成为 1969 年百大热门歌曲之一。
cues.en: Color Him Father went on to win a Grammy Award for the band, becoming one of the top 100 hits of 1969.

cues.zh: 这大概是这支乐队最出名的一首曲子。
cues.en: It's probably the track for which the band is best known.

cues.zh: 然而，正是B面的《Amen, Brother》，在歌曲正中间有一段经典的鼓击段落，非常适合采样。
cues.en: However, it's the B-side, Amen, Brother, that has that classic drum breakdown right in the middle of the song, which makes it perfect for sampling.

cues.zh: 再听一遍，这次多放一些曲子的其余部分，好给个上下文。
cues.en: Here it is again, with more of the rest of the track included to give it context.

cues.zh: 《Amen, Brother》录了、发了、播了，来了又走，没什么特别了不起的。
cues.en: So, Amen, Brother was recorded, it was released, it was played, it came and went, nothing terribly remarkable about it.

cues.zh: 然而，随着1980年代采样器的出现，歌曲中间那段鼓循环被复活了。
cues.en: However, the drum loop in the middle of the song was resuscitated with the advent of the sampler in the 1980s.

cues.zh: 稍插一句关于采样器：这台机器大约录像机大小，用户可以录进任何声音，快速回放和编排。
cues.en: Just a brief aside about the sampler, this was a machine about the size of a VCR that allowed its user to record any sound into it for quick playback and arrangement.

cues.zh: 采样器和唱盘机，是促成嘻哈诞生与发展的主要工具。
cues.en: The sampler, as well as the turntable, were principal tools largely responsible for the birth and development of hip hop.

cues.zh: 有了采样器，任何鼓点、任何吉他 riff、任何能录下来的声音，都能成为新作品的一部分，获得新的语境。
cues.en: With a sampler, any drum beat, any guitar riff, any sound that could be recorded could be used as part of a new composition, a new contextualization.

cues.zh: 如今，几乎所有商业制作的音乐，至少有一部分是用采样器完成的。
cues.en: Nowadays, almost all commercially produced music has been at least in part realized with a sampler.

cues.zh: 但嘻哈和其他电子音乐流派率先创造性地使用采样器，而 Amen break 是最早被拿来实验的鼓采样之一。
cues.en: But hip hop and other electronic-based music genres pioneered the creative use of samplers and the Amen break was one of the first drum samples to be experimented with.

cues.zh: 这是一个早期例子：纽约双人组合 Third Bass 1989 年发行的曲目 Words of Wisdom。
cues.en: Here's an early example, the track Words of Wisdom by New York duo Third Bass, released in 1989.

cues.zh: 还有一个例子：NWA 的曲目 Straight Outta Compton，同样出自 1989 年。
cues.en: And here's another, an NWA's track, Straight Outta Compton, also from 1989.

cues.zh: 最后是 Mantronix 的 King of the Beats，来自 1990 年。
cues.en: Finally, here is Mantronix with King of the Beats from 1990.

cues.zh: 这些例子中，都用了一段一小节的 Amen 循环来构建节奏。
cues.en: In these cases, a one-bar loop of the Amen was used to create the rhythms.

cues.zh: 也就是说，这是对 break 相当直接的一种用法。
cues.en: That is to say it's a fairly straightforward use of the break.

cues.zh: 随着时间推移，采样器越来越复杂，用法也越来越复杂。
cues.en: As time went on, and samplers became more complex, so did their usage.

cues.zh: 在英国，就在《Straight Outta Compton》发行前后，当地的锐舞场景爆发了，音乐人和 DJ 用采样器和 Amen break 制作 hardcore techno。
cues.en: In the UK, right around the time Straight Outta Compton is released, the rave scene there explodes with musicians and DJs who used samplers and the Amen break to produce hardcore techno.

cues.zh: raga jungle 和 drum and bass。
cues.en: raga jungle and drum and bass.

cues.zh: 尤其是 Jungle，它融合了 reggae toasting、厚重贝斯线和高速度 breakbeat。
cues.en: Jungle in particular, it being an amalgamation of reggae toasting, heavy bass lines and high speed break beats.

cues.zh: 它的美学几乎完全围绕对 Amen 的解构展开。
cues.en: centers its aesthetic almost entirely around the deconstruction of the Amen.

cues.zh: 做法是把原始六秒采样切成一个个单独的鼓击。
cues.en: This was done by slicing the original six-second sample into its individual drum hits.

cues.zh: 每一个军鼓、每一个底鼓、踩镲、crash 镲。
cues.en: Each snare drum, each bass drum, the hi-hats, the crash symbol.

cues.zh: 然后这些切片可以任意重新排列和处理，创造新的节奏型。
cues.en: The slices could then be rearranged and manipulated in any number of ways to create new patterns.

cues.zh: 这位是更早的 jungle 音乐人，这是 Shy FX 1994 年的曲目《Original Nuttah》。
cues.en: Here's an earlier jungle artist, this is Shy FX's track Original Nuttah from 1994.

cues.zh: 另一首是 L Double 和 Young Head 的《New Style》，出自 1996 年。
cues.en: And here's another by L Double and Young Head titled New Style from 1996.

cues.zh: 像这样的 Amen 曲目很多，通过醋酸酯测试盘——也就是所谓的 dub plate——很容易传播给听众。
cues.en: Amen tracks like these were plentiful and easily disseminated to their audiences via acetate test pressings, or dub plates as they're called.

cues.zh: 这些一次性录音不同于通常要压制 1,000 张以上的量产黑胶唱片，过去和现在都制作便宜，而且能快速刻制。
cues.en: These one-off recordings, unlike mass-produced vinyl records that typically had to be pressed in quantities of 1,000 or more, were and still are cheap to make and could be cut quickly.

cues.zh: 音乐人早上可以做一首 Amen 曲目，下午刻好 dub plate，晚上让 DJ 放给人群听。
cues.en: A musician could make an Amen track in the morning, get a dub plate cut that afternoon, and have a DJ play it to a crowd that night.

cues.zh: 不过 dub plate 寿命不长，播放约 50 次后就会磨损。
cues.en: Dub plates don't last very long, however, and can only be played about 50 times before they wear out.

cues.zh: 你现在听到的这段录音，就是一个 dubplate 的例子。
cues.en: The recording you are listening to now is an example of a dub plate.

cues.zh: 不管怎样，随着 jungle 走红，反应就是那帮摸着下巴、故作深沉的文艺人群，他们以某种……的名义把 Amen 当成了自己的东西。
cues.en: In any event, with jungle's popularity, what you got in reaction was this sort of chin stroking art crowd who took the Amen as their own in the name of a sort of.

cues.zh: 就像有人可能会说的，一种故作高雅的姿态。
cues.en: as some might say, a high brow posturing.

cues.zh: 他们接着在使用中把荒诞程度不断推高。
cues.en: They proceeded to push the levels of absurdity with its use.

cues.zh: 把编曲摆弄到超出可舞性和切分节奏的限度，进入纯粹恋物化和自我放纵的领域。
cues.en: really tweaking the arrangements beyond a point of danceability and syncopation and into a realm of pure fetishization and self-indulgence.

cues.zh: 这是英国的 Tom Jenkinson，也就是 Squarepusher，带来 1997 年的曲目《Vic Acid》。
cues.en: Here's the UK's Tom Jenkinson, aka Squarepusher, with the track Vic Acid from 1997.

cues.zh: 以及美国的 Keith Whitman，也就是 Havratzky，带来他 1998 年的曲目《Routine Exercise》。
cues.en: And the US's Keith Whitman, aka Havratzky, with his track Routine Exercise from 1998.

cues.zh: 现在，稍微快进一下：如果你收听网络电台 www.ragajungle.com。
cues.en: And now, just to fast forward a bit, if you tune in to the internet radio station www.ragajungle.com.

cues.zh: 你一天24小时、一周七天，都会被 Amen break 无穷无尽的变体轮番“按摩”。
cues.en: you'll be massaged by endless permutations of the Amen break 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

cues.zh: 尽管丛林和鼓打贝斯如今已出现十多年，它们仍拥有死忠粉，哪怕这份忠诚部分源于对早期英国场景的怀旧。
cues.en: Despite jungle and drum and bass being over 10 years old now, they still have their hardcore fans, even if they base their devotion partly on the nostalgia of the early UK scene.

cues.zh: 我觉得这相当有意思。
cues.en: I find this quite interesting.

cues.zh: 数百首曲目、几十位 DJ、一批俱乐部和活动，实际上整个亚文化，都建立在这一段鼓循环之上。
cues.en: Hundreds of tracks, dozens of DJs, a number of clubs and events, in effect an entire subculture, based on this one drum loop.

cues.zh: 我是说，建立在1969年的六秒钟之上。
cues.en: I mean, based on six seconds from 1969.

cues.zh: Amen Break 究竟有什么魔力？
cues.en: What is it about the Amen Break?

cues.zh: 它为什么这么迷人？
cues.en: What's the fascination?

cues.zh: 是军鼓的冲击力，还是这段循环的整体律动？显然，它似乎感染了许多音乐人，这里还有一个例子，而且算是挺怪的一个：Perry Farrell——有些人知道他是 Jane's Addiction 和 Porno for Pyros 的主唱——做了一版某种摇滚与丛林混合的 Led Zeppelin《Whole Lotta Love》翻唱。
cues.en: Is it the punch of the snare drum or maybe the overall groove of the loop? Obviously, it seems to have infected a great many musicians, here's one more example and a kind of odd one of that, Perry Farrell, as some know as the front man for Jane's Addiction and Porno for Pyros, making some kind of hybrid rock jungle cover of Led Zeppelin's Whole Lotta Love.

cues.zh: 说来讽刺，原版《Whole Lotta Love》由 Led Zeppelin 于1969年发行。
cues.en: The original Whole Lotta Love, ironically enough, was released by Led Zeppelin in 1969.

cues.zh: 同年，《Amen, Brother》也发行了。
cues.en: the same year Amen, Brother was released.

cues.zh: 确实，Amen Break 似乎相当能适应各种音乐流派和口味。
cues.en: Indeed, the Amen Break appears quite adaptable to a range of music genres and tastes.

cues.zh: 所以也许一个重要的问题是：这一切发生时，The Winstons 在哪里？
cues.en: So perhaps an important question is, where are The Winstons during all this?

cues.zh: 20世纪90年代，美国和海外基于采样的音乐都迅速兴起。他们有没有亲眼见证，自己的 break beat 从婴儿潮一代的灵魂乐律动，变成地下电子音乐的常用素材？
cues.en: Sample based music both in the US and abroad mushroomed during the 1990s. Were they around to witness the transformation of their break beat from a baby boomer soul groove into a staple for underground electronic music?

cues.zh: 乐队里有谁在意它被 rave 和嘻哈音乐人公然挪用、而且似乎未经同意吗？
cues.en: Did any of the members of the band care about its blatant appropriation, seemingly without consent, by musicians in rave and hip hop?

cues.zh: 也许 Richard Spencer——The Winstons 的创始成员、《Amen, Brother》的版权持有人，而且有意思的是，他离开了音乐行业，后来取得了政治学博士学位——根本不在意。
cues.en: Perhaps Richard Spencer, a founding member of The Winstons and the copyright holder of Amen, Brother, and who interestingly enough left the music biz and later received a PhD in political science, simply didn't care.

cues.zh: 也许他和嘻哈早期年代的许多人一样，并不认为它和其他采样音乐除了有限的地下吸引力之外还有什么潜力。
cues.en: Perhaps he, like many people during hip hop's early years, didn't see it and other sample-based music as having any potential beyond a limited underground appeal.

cues.zh: 80年代，DJ们翻挖老爵士和R&B唱片寻找采样素材时，嘻哈尤其如此，电子音乐整体亦然，它们都不是今天我们所知的流行现象和赚钱机器。
cues.en: During the '80s when DJs plundered old jazz and R&B records looking for samples, hip hop in particular and electronic music in general were not the pop phenomena and money makers we know them as today.

cues.zh: 当时似乎有过短短几年所谓的黄金时期，采样的新奇性以及它作为一种新技术被采用的速度，增长得比任何版权官僚体系维护法律的速度都快。更早的采样片段被拿来使用，或许是假定它们能被自由使用，本着对新形式宣誓的精神。
cues.en: There seemed to be a brief few sort of glory years back then when the novelty of sampling and the rate at which it was being employed as a new technique grew faster than the rate at which any sort of copyright bureaucracy could maintain the law. Older bits of sampling were appropriated perhaps under the assumption of there being able to be freely used, in the spirit of a pledge to new forms.

cues.zh: 换句话说，采样并不只是被看作翻炒过去的声音，而是试图从旧事物中创造出新事物。
cues.en: In other words, sampling was not seen as merely rehashing past sounds, but as an attempt to make new from something old.

cues.zh: 一种和创造性表达本身一样历史悠久的艺术策略。只有当这些城市音乐形式开始备受关注、赚得盆满钵满时。
cues.en: An artistic strategy as time honored as creative expression itself. Only when these urban forms began receiving a lot of attention and making a lot of money.

cues.zh: 人们——更重要的是，持有大量当代美国音乐旧曲目版权的公司大亨——才开始严厉打击版权侵权行为。
cues.en: did people and more importantly, corporate bigwigs who held the copyrights to much of the back catalog of contemporary American music start cracking down on copyright violation.

cues.zh: 不过值得注意的是，The Winstons——顺便说一句，他们今天仍然存在，虽然只是名义上，因为原始成员都已不再在乐队里演出——从未就过去20年里数百起擅自使用 Amen Break 的事件采取法律行动。
cues.en: Remarkably though, The Winstons, who by the way do still exist today, although in name only as none of the original members play in the band any longer, never pursued legal action against those hundreds of instances of the Amen Break's appropriation over the last 20 years.

cues.zh: 看起来，Amen 因为被全世界的制作人和 DJ 大量使用，已经进入某种公共领域——即便在法律上不是，在文化上也肯定是了。无论如何，在 jungle 从地下俱乐部状态转变为媒体喜欢称呼的更亲民的电子乐的过程中。
cues.en: It seemed the Amen, by the sheer amount of its use by producers and DJs around the world, had entered into a type of public domain, if not legally, then certainly culturally. At any rate, during jungle's transformation from an underground club status to a more user friendly electronica, as the media likes to call it.

cues.zh: 一连串奇怪的事件发生了。广告公司总是寻找新角度，借助边缘青年当下在听的东西来推销消费品。
cues.en: A curious chain of events happened. Advertising agencies, always looking for new angles to help pedal consumer products by tapping into what the kids on the margins are listening to these days.

cues.zh: 开始在电视广告中使用碎拍，包括 Amen。
cues.en: started using break beats, including the Amen, in television commercials.

cues.zh: 比如，这是南加州正在播的一则 Jeep 广告，宣传他们的 Extreme Jeep Snow 活动。
cues.en: For example, here's a Jeep ad running in Southern California right now, promoting their Extreme Jeep Snow event.

cues.zh: 这时，有人注意到碎拍音乐人气上升，并意识到希望使用 Amen 碎拍的商业制作人市场正在扩大。
cues.en: Now, noticing a rise in popularity in break beat music and recognizing a growing market of commercial producers wishing to use the Amen break.

cues.zh: 第三方公司开始通过看似完全合法的渠道销售它。
cues.en: Third party companies started selling it through what seemed to be completely legal channels.

cues.zh: 例如，20世纪90年代末，一家名为 Zero-G Limited 的英国公司开始销售 Jungle 素材套件——也就是采样 CD，里面包含数百段 breakbeat，包括 Amen。这是他们的版本，来自他们的《Jungle Warfare》采样 CD；顺便说一句，版权标注为 Zero-G 2002 年。
cues.en: For example, at the end of the 1990s, a UK company by the name of Zero-G Limited started selling jungle construction kits, sample CDs containing hundreds of break beats, including the Amen. Here is their version of it, from their jungle warfare sample CD, which by the way, is copyrighted 2002 by Zero-G.

cues.zh: 这里再次是原始的 Amen Break，取自我在 eBay 上买到的 The Winstons 真实黑胶发行版，版权标注为 1969 年。
cues.en: And here is the original Amen Break again, taken from the actual Winstons vinyl release I bought off eBay, copyrighted 1969.

cues.zh: 我把这段 break 稍微加速，以匹配 Jungle 的速度。
cues.en: I sped the break up slightly to match a jungle tempo.

cues.zh: 我觉得不难断定，Zero-G 挪用了 Amen。
cues.en: I don't think it's much of a stretch to conclude that Zero-G appropriated the Amen.

cues.zh: 尽管根据他们的包装说明，他们保证该素材套件中的所有采样都是专门为它制作的。
cues.en: Although according to their packaging, they guarantee that all samples in the construction kit have been created specially for it.

cues.zh: 同样，他们的资料里也从未提到向 The Winstons 取得 Amen 的任何授权。
cues.en: Likewise, nowhere in their literature does it mention any licensing of the Amen from The Winstons.

cues.zh: 所以，同一份素材出现了两项版权。
cues.en: So, here we have two copyrights of the same material.

cues.zh: 怎么会这样？
cues.en: How can this be?

cues.zh: 此外，我虽然可以用 Zero-G 版本的 Amen 来制作并销售音乐，
cues.en: Furthermore, while I can use Zero-G's version of the Amen to make and sell music.

cues.zh: 但我并不拥有从他们那里买来的 Amen 采样。
cues.en: I don't own the Amen sample I bought from them.

cues.zh: 我拥有的只是他们授予我的使用许可。
cues.en: I only own a license from them to use it.

cues.zh: 我不能拿他们的 Amen 来制作并销售我自己的 sample CD 套件。
cues.en: I cannot take their Amen and make and sell my own sample CD kit.

cues.zh: 因此，在某些方面，如今 Amen 与其说属于 The Winstons，不如说更属于像 Zero-G Limited 这样的公司。
cues.en: Thus, in some ways, the Amen belongs less now to The Winstons and more to companies like Zero-G Limited.

cues.zh: 我为什么要提这些？
cues.en: Why do I bring any of this up?

cues.zh: Amen break 有什么重要意义？
cues.en: What is significant about the Amen break?

cues.zh: 我在这里谈它，是因为我觉得它的故事是个很好的例子，能说明数字采样在当今日益严格的版权和商标法下如何兴起、又为何变得问题重重。追溯 Amen break 的历史，就是在追溯那样一段短暂时期的历史：当时数字工具似乎提供了几乎无限的新表达形式，文化生产——至少在音乐上——充满可能性，因为人们可以自由取用音乐过去，做出新的组合，从而产生新的意义。
cues.en: I'm talking about it here because I think its story is a good example illustrating the rise and subsequent problematic of digital sampling in relation to today's increasingly stringent copyright and trademark laws. To trace the history of the Amen break is to trace the history of a brief period of time when it seemed digital tools offered a potentially unlimited amount of new forms of expression, where cultural production, at least musically, was full of possibilities by virtue of being able to freely appropriate from the musical past, to make new combinations and thus new meanings.

cues.zh: 这个故事表明，一个“可以自由借用过去并在此基础上发展”的社会，在文化上比受控的社会更丰富。
cues.en: The story demonstrates that a society, quote, free to borrow and build upon the past, is culturally richer than a controlled one, unquote.

cues.zh: 用 Lawrence Lessig 的话说——他是斯坦福法学院教授、版权改革倡导者，也是 Creative Commons 的联合创始人，该组织提供了一种替代版权控制的合法方案。
cues.en: To use the words of Lawrence Lessig, Stanford Law Professor, copyright reform advocate, and co-founder of Creative Commons, an organization offering a legal alternative to copyright control.

cues.zh: 随着我们向前发展，像 Amen Break 这样的例子会越来越少，甚至可能不复存在。
cues.en: As we go forward, examples like the Amen Break will become more and more rare, if non-existent.

cues.zh: 联邦第六巡回上诉法院今年九月裁定，录音艺人使用任何不属于公有领域的样本都必须付费，无论样本长短或是否可识别。但由于美国版权法的多项修改，例如1976年《版权法》和1998年《Sonny Bono版权延长法》——后者将版权保护期延长到了21世纪中叶。
cues.en: A sixth circuit federal appeals court ruled in September of this year that recording artists must pay for every sample they use, not in the public domain, regardless of the length or recognizability of the samples in question. But because of various changes to US copyright laws, for example, the Copyright Act of 1976 and the Sonny Bono Copyright Extension Act of 1998, which extended copyrights into the mid 21st century.

cues.zh: 几乎整个20世纪的文化产出都被锁在公共领域之外，禁止采样，除非你有雄厚财力请得起昂贵律师。
cues.en: virtually all 20th century cultural output has been locked away from the public domain, barred from sampling, unless one has deep pockets and expensive lawyers.

cues.zh: 所以看起来，像 Zero-G 这样的公司，试图监管 Amen Break 的使用并从中获利，反而在帮助巩固版权法的至高地位；而这家公司自身的成功，恰恰是因为围绕 break beat 采样的严格版权控制缺失。
cues.en: So it seems a company like Zero-G, with its attempt at regulating the use of and profiting from the use of the Amen Break, is helping to secure the supremacy of copyright laws, while the company's very success itself occurred because of a lack of strict copyright control surrounding break beat sampling.

cues.zh: 换句话说，版权灵活时，不仅文化内部的创新会增长，其市场和资本也会增长。
cues.en: In other words, not only does the innovation within culture grow when copyright is flexible, so do its markets and capital.

cues.zh: 新潮流被开发出来，新声音被追捧。新作品备受期待，大受欢迎，甚至售罄。新明星诞生，新粉丝群体形成，金钱流转，这一切都在追求新的形式与体验，追求新连接与新意义的潜能。我认为 Amen Break 的使用史证明了这一点。
cues.en: New trends are developed, new sounds are sought after. New releases are anticipated and become hugely popular, perhaps even selling out. New stars are born and new fan bases are created, money is exchanged, all in the pursuit of new forms and experiences, of potentials for new connections and meanings. I think the history of the use of the Amen Break demonstrates this.

cues.zh: 引用联邦第九巡回上诉法院法官 Alex Kozinsky 去年在一份版权裁决中的话：“过度保护知识产权与保护不足同样有害。”
cues.en: To cite federal Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals judge Alex Kozinsky in a copyright ruling last year, quote, overprotecting intellectual property is as harmful as underprotecting it.

cues.zh: 没有丰富的公共领域，文化就无从谈起。
cues.en: Culture is impossible without a rich public domain.

cues.zh: 今天没有任何东西是真正全新的，就像自我们驯服火焰以来也没有一样。
cues.en: Nothing today, like nothing since we tamed fire, is genuinely new.

cues.zh: 文化如同科学与技术，靠累积而成长，每一位新的创作者都建立在前人作品之上。
cues.en: Culture, like science and technology, grows by accretion, each new creator building on the works of those who came before.

cues.zh: 过度保护恰恰扼杀了它本应培育的创造力。”
cues.en: Overprotection stifles the very creative forces it's supposed to nurture, unquote.
